messages.subject: Latest xlsxjars  package?
parts:
Greetings,

I downloaded  the latest xlsx package for the indexing fix (thanks!)

Now I am getting a java.lang.NullPointerException in ReadColStrings. I noticed that you have some fixes in this method of RInterface. 

The latest xlsxjars on downloads is from March. How would I get/build that latest jar? 

Thanks,

Kate Davis

ps. I use many spreadsheets, so I am happy to stress test any release!

messages.author: 1db601ea1fed90a0
messages.subject: Re: Latest xlsxjars  package?
parts:
No new release of xlsxjars is needed.  The current version of the xlsx is 0.5.4 from code.google.com.

install.packages("xlsxjars_0.5.0.tar.gz", type="source")
install.packages("xlsx_0.5.4.tar.gz", type="source")

Please report issues with this version on https://code.google.com/p/rexcel/issues/list  by providing a reproducible example.

Thank you for helping with testing,
Adrian
